name: Golden-hour fields
one_line: Tall wheat glowing amber, long shadows, a dusty track.
look_words: Open farmland in the last hour of sun. Wheat and dry grass in amber and straw, a pale dusty track, weathered wood and stone, a few dark poplars. The sun sits low and orange, shadows are long and warm, and the far hills go blue in the haze. Shapes are broad and simple with visible brush marks. Because the whole world is gold, the things that matter are cool: teal and clean white for pickups and the goal, a clear red for harm, a blue cloak for the player. Motion is wind: grass in waves, dust behind hooves, swallows. Avoid green lawns, midday light, grey skies, gloss and bloom on the sun.

palette.name: golden hour
palette.notes: A gold world needs cool accents. The sun is very low (12 degrees), so shadows are long: place things so they do not hide the path.

upgrade.why: a field to the horizon that bends under feet and hooves
warm low haze so the distance glows

music.mood: slow fiddle and guitar, wide and warm

sound_feel: wind in grass, hooves on dirt, insects, a creaking wheel
